summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing a distance voting ballot for an Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) scheduled for May 28, 2026. The filing provides instructions for shareholders to vote remotely on agenda items, including potential separate election of board members by minority shareholders. No special-situation transaction—acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or similar event—is announced. The document is a routine procedural meeting notice with voting mechanics under Brazilian CVM Resolution 81, equivalent to a US proxy or meeting reminder. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions are discussed.
